description: This file defines the Dependency class used for representing and managing dependency information within Drupal, including version constraints and compatibility checks.

classes.name: Dependency
classes.description: A value object representing dependency information, including name, project, and version constraints, with methods for creation, compatibility checking, and serialization control.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Dependency object with name, project, and constraint string.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Returns the project namespace for the dependency.

methods.name: getConstraint
methods.description: Returns the Constraint object, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: isCompatible
methods.description: Checks if a given version is compatible with the dependency's constraint.

methods.name: createFromString
methods.description: Creates a Dependency instance from a dependency string with optional project and version constraints.

methods.name: __sleep
methods.description: Prepares the object for serialization by returning relevant properties.
